questions.question:
The statements below are followed by two conclusions labelled I and II. Assuming that the information in the statements is true, even if it appears at variance with generally established facts, decide which conclusion(s) logically and definitely follow(s) from the information given in the statements.

**Statements:**

I. All mustards are corns.

II. All corns are olives.

**Conclusion:**

I. All mustards are olives.

II. Some olives are mustards.

options.text: Either conclusion I or conclusion II follows.

questions.solution:
__Concept:__

__
 
• Meaning of "Some A are B" in Syllogism - there is at least one point in A which is in B.
 
• Meaning of "All A are B" in Syllogism - each point of A is in B.
 
• This explains why "some" can be considered as a subset of "all".
 
• Therefore, *if "All A are B" is true, then "some A are B" is always true.*

***The least possible Venn diagram is,*__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d54409b8d609b0734cb61f1d3dc05cc8d528ca662c929ae2c7dbb8e8ba5c70b9.png] 

__***Conclusion I: ***__All mustards are olives → True (This is definitely true)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3657567962a8d8d7ff8ddaaa9f79901fed9ca155c94a04423af1d76eae0cbf82.png] 

**__*Conclusion II:*__** Some olives are mustards → True (This is definitely true)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3657567962a8d8d7ff8ddaaa9f79901fed9ca155c94a04423af1d76eae0cbf82.png] 

Hence,** “both conclusions follow".**

questions.question:
Find out the two signs to be interchanged to make the following equation correct.

25 + 5 × 7 – 12 ÷ 3 = 26
questions.solution:
Interchanging the signs and using BODMAS rule,

**Option 1 → + and ÷**

The original equation is,

25 + 5 × 7 – 12 ÷ 3 = 26

Interchanging the signs,

25 ÷ 5 × 7 – 12 + 3 = 26

Using BODMAS rule,

5 × 7 – 12 + 3 = 26

35 – 12 + 3 = 26

38 – 12 = 26

26 = 26

**Option 2 → + and × **

The original equation is,

25 + 5 × 7 – 12 ÷ 3 = 26

Interchanging the signs,

25 × 5 + 7 – 12 ÷ 3 = 26

Using BODMAS rule,

25 × 5 + 7 – 4 = 26

125 + 7 – 4 = 26

132 – 4 is not equal to 26

**Option 3 → – and ÷ **

The original equation is,

25 + 5 × 7 – 12 ÷ 3 = 26

Interchanging the signs,

25 + 5 × 7 ÷ 12 – 3 = 26

Using BODMAS rule,

25 + 5 × 7/ 12 – 3 = 26

25 + 35/ 12 – 3 is not equal to 26

**Option 4 → + and –**

The original equation is,

25 + 5 × 7 – 12 ÷ 3 = 26

Interchanging the signs,

25 – 5 × 7 + 12 ÷ 3 = 26

Using BODMAS rule,

25 – 5 × 7 + 4 = 26

25 – 35 + 4 = 26

29 – 35 is not equal to 26

Hence, option 1 is the correct answer

questions.question:
The statements below are followed by two conclusions labelled I and II. Assuming that the information in the statements is true, even if it appears at variance with generally established facts, decide which conclusion(s) logically and definitely follow(s) from the information given in the statements.

**Statements:**

II. Some garments are garnets.

**Conclusion:**

I. Some rubies are garnets.

II. No ruby is a garnet.

options.text: Either conclusion I or conclusion II follows.
